name: Dr. Siddhant Arya
summary: Krrish's first villain: a scientist obsessed with a supercomputer that can show the future. Played by Naseeruddin Shah in Krrish (2006).
origin: Arya hired the gifted Rohit Mehra to help build a machine that could see into the future. When Rohit discovered Arya's selfish plans and wrecked the machine, Arya shot him, then kept him in a coma for years, because the rebuilt computer only worked with Rohit's heartbeat and retina scans. Krishna grew up believing his father was dead, and his mother Nisha died soon after Rohit vanished.
powers: Ruthless, will shoot allies and enemies alike

storyline.title: The future machine
storyline.beat: Arya and Rohit build a computer to see the future. Rohit sabotages it, and Arya shoots him and holds him captive.

storyline.title: A prisoner in a coma
storyline.beat: Arya keeps Rohit unconscious because his heartbeat and eyes are the keys that run the rebuilt machine.

storyline.title: Seeing his own death
storyline.beat: The computer shows Krrish killing Arya. He murders Kristian to change that future, but the prediction stays the same.

storyline.title: Island showdown
storyline.beat: Arya shoots his security chief Vikram Sinha and takes hostages. Krrish rescues them and fatally wounds him.

storyline.title: A dark legacy
storyline.beat: Krrish 3 reveals that Arya's experiment on Rohit created the villain Kaal.

gossip.text: Arya's supercomputer was biometrically locked to Rohit's heartbeat and retina, which is why Arya kept him alive for years.
He saw his own death coming, tried to rewrite the future, and failed.
Years after his death, Krrish 3 revealed that his old experiment had created the villain Kaal.
Naseeruddin Shah's Arya earned a Best Villain nomination at the 52nd Filmfare Awards.

quiz.q: What does Dr. Arya's machine do?
quiz.why: His supercomputer was built to see the future.
Naseeruddin Shah played the scientist in Krrish (2006).

quiz.q: What does Arya's machine need to run?
quiz.why: It is locked to Rohit, which is why Arya kept him alive.

quiz.q: Which later villain began as Arya's failed experiment?
quiz.why: Krrish 3 reveals that Kaal grew from Arya's experiment.

theme.tagline: He peeked at tomorrow and hated the ending.

timeline.title: Naseeruddin Shah's mad genius
timeline.note: Arya arrives in Krrish as a scientist fixated on a computer that can see the future.

timeline.title: Island showdown
timeline.note: His machine shows Krrish killing him; he commits murder to change that, but Krrish storms his island and fatally wounds him.

timeline.title: Filmfare villain nomination
timeline.note: Naseeruddin Shah is nominated for Best Performance in a Negative Role for playing Arya.

timeline.title: His lab made Kaal
timeline.note: Shah returns in a special appearance in Krrish 3, which reveals that Arya's experiment produced the villain Kaal.

facts.text: Arya's rebuilt supercomputer only works with Rohit's heartbeat and retinal scans, so he kept Rohit in a coma while it was being rebuilt.
On the night Krishna was born, Rohit said he was quitting the project; Arya held him at gunpoint, Rohit smashed the machine, and Arya shot him.
When Arya consults the rebuilt computer it shows Krrish killing him, so he goes to the stunt performer Kristian and shoots him.
Arya asks the computer a second time, but the predicted future has not changed.
As he lies dying, Arya asks the masked hero who he is, and Krishna answers by revealing his identity.
Krrish 3 reveals that Arya once tried to make a copy of Rohit but got a child born with a disability, whom he left at an orphanage; the boy was adopted and grew up to become the villain Kaal.
Kaal, a genius with telekinetic powers, founded Kaal Laboratory and created the Maanvars, mutants made by fusing human and animal serum, so Arya's old experiment fed a new set of monsters.
The future-seeing supercomputer outlives Arya: at the end of Krrish, Rohit uses it to send signals into space, hoping to reach the alien Jadoo.
Shah also played Captain Nemo opposite Sean Connery in the Hollywood film The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen (2003).
Arya's supercomputer was officially meant to predict future calamities, yet the franchise's character guide says he wanted a future-seeing computer in order to rule the world.
Vikram Sinha, Arya's own senior security officer, was secretly Rohit's close friend and spent twenty years searching for Krishna and his grandmother Sonia.

Sonia took five-year-old Krishna to a remote village in Himachal Pradesh to hide his abilities after his school suspected he had a very high IQ, and Sinha needed about twenty years to track them down.
Krrish was released on 23 June 2006 on over 1000 prints with a budget of 40 crore rupees, both near-record figures for an Indian film at that time.
Krrish earned about 126 crore rupees worldwide, making it the second highest-grossing Indian film of 2006, behind Dhoom 2.
Krrish's action scenes were choreographed by Tony Ching, and its effects team was helped by Marc Kolbe and Craig Mumma, since the film aimed for Hollywood-level visual effects.
Krrish was among the first Indian productions to mix large-scale CGI with wire-work stunts, and it became the highest-grossing Indian superhero film of its day.
The film got 8 nominations at the 52nd Filmfare Awards, including Best Film, and won 3, including Best Special Effects.
Naseeruddin Shah has won the National Film Award for Best Actor twice, for Sparsh and Paar, and won Best Supporting Actor for Iqbal in 2006, the same year Krrish came out.
Shah was awarded the Padma Shri in 1987 and the Padma Bhushan in 2003, India's fourth and third highest civilian honours.
In 1988 Shah played the poet Mirza Ghalib in a television series of the same name, directed by Gulzar and shown on DD National.

kidSummary: Dr. Siddhant Arya is the first villain of the Krrish movies. He is a scientist who wants a computer to see the future, and he does terrible things to stop a future where Krrish beats him.

story.title: A computer for the future
story.text: Arya hires the clever scientist Rohit to help build a supercomputer that can predict what will happen.

story.title: A bad plan
story.text: When Rohit sees that Arya has selfish plans, he breaks the machine. Arya keeps him as a prisoner because the rebuilt computer needs Rohit to work.

story.title: A scary vision
story.text: The computer shows Krrish defeating him. Arya tries to change the future, but when he asks again the answer is the same.

story.title: The island
story.text: Krrish comes to Arya's island, frees Rohit and Priya, and stops him.

story.title: A shadow in the next film
story.text: Krrish 3 shows that Arya's old experiment led to the villain Kaal.
